context: The Binance incident investigation now includes failed XRPL transactions, a failed RLUSD payment, issuer freezes, Circle CCTP use in an AVAX-to-ETH path, Aave USDT collateral, and a newer official Binance replenishment statement.
decision: Store successful XRPL Payments, failed tec transactions, dust transfers, CheckCreate and CheckCash as separate event types. Failed attempts are not asset flows.
Do not count the failed 42,750,000.1 RLUSD attempt as an executed transfer or as attacker-held RLUSD.
Do not add the five failed XRP retries to the 233,461,943.1 XRP successful-transfer total; record the extra rhWj9g… wallet only as a failed attempt.
Exclude the XRPLWin 22:35 UTC Check observation from this 22:03:36 UTC snapshot because it is future-dated relative to the cutoff.
Model issuer-freeze capability for issued USDC/RLUSD separately from native XRP, which cannot be frozen by an issuer under XRPL protocol rules.
Record Circle CCTP as a rail reportedly used in a stolen-asset bridge path; do not infer Circle intent, authorization or complicity.
Keep Aave USDT collateral/ETH borrowing separate from XRP collateralization.
Treat Binance's remaining 20% acquisition as aggregate affected-token replenishment; no XRP-specific demand feature is admitted.
Retain Elliptic's DPRK attribution as a competing hypothesis with disconfirming evidence, not as a confirmed identity.
Keep live-page price/OI captures out of the feature store until timestamp, venue, contract universe and source coverage are harmonized.
invariants: No market feature admitted from this snapshot.
No real-money trade or paper-state mutation.
No main-branch modification, merge, force-push or workflow dispatch.
Preserve failed and superseded observations; append corrections rather than rewriting history.
